items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: but I asked Russell Malone about it. He said, “Well, I came, I grew up in Florida.”

ctx.x: I’ll find it. Anyway, I was so thrilled that we had an African American guy as President, and both Sonny and Bobby Cranshaw said they had not voted for him. And I never wanted to go into it, but I asked Russell Malone about it. He said, “Well, I came, I grew up in Florida.” He said, “Everybody down there was votin’ for that other guy whose name I can’t even say (laughs), who was the President for eight years before.” So I have no idea. Yeah, it’s a bit bizarre, isn’t it? Unless they voted for… what’s her name?…
